Package com.example.cosmos_discovery.database

Class EventService

java.lang.Object
com.example.cosmos_discovery.database.EventService
public class EventService extends Object
Provides event-related Firestore operations. All methods are async. Use Consumer<T> onSuccess for results and Consumer<String> onFailure for error messages — the same pattern as AuthService.

  • Method Details

    • listenThisWeekEvents

      public com.google.firebase.firestore.ListenerRegistration listenThisWeekEvents(Consumer<List<Event>> onUpdate, Consumer<String> onError)
      Attaches a real-time listener for approved events in the current calendar week (Sunday 00:00 → Saturday 23:59:59). onUpdate fires immediately with the current data, then again whenever a document is added, changed, or removed. NOTE: Requires a composite Firestore index on (status ASC, dateTime ASC). On first run, Logcat will print a link — click it to auto-create the index.
      Returns:
      a ListenerRegistration — call .remove() in onStop() to detach and stop streaming updates.

    • listenUpcomingEvents

      public com.google.firebase.firestore.ListenerRegistration listenUpcomingEvents(Consumer<List<Event>> onUpdate, Consumer<String> onError)
      Attaches a real-time listener for all approved events with a future dateTime, ordered chronologically. Use this for a full "upcoming events" feed.
      Returns:
      a ListenerRegistration — call .remove() in onStop()

    • listenMyRsvpedEvents

      public com.google.firebase.firestore.ListenerRegistration listenMyRsvpedEvents(String userId, Consumer<List<Event>> onUpdate, Consumer<String> onError)
      Attaches a real-time listener for all events where userId is in the attendeeIds array (i.e. the user has RSVPed). Returns the full list unsorted — callers should split and sort client-side into upcoming / past. Uses a single array-contains filter, which requires no composite index.
      Returns:
      a ListenerRegistration — call .remove() in onStop()

    • fetchMyRsvpedEvents

      public void fetchMyRsvpedEvents(String userId, Consumer<List<Event>> onSuccess, Consumer<String> onError)
      One-time fetch of all events the user has RSVPed to — used by For You so that recommendations don't refresh mid-session when the user RSVPs.

    • listenOrganizerEvents

      public com.google.firebase.firestore.ListenerRegistration listenOrganizerEvents(String organizerId, Consumer<List<Event>> onUpdate, Consumer<String> onError)
      Attaches a real-time listener for all events created by the given organizer. No server-side ordering — callers sort client-side after splitting by status.
      Returns:
      a ListenerRegistration — call .remove() in onStop().

    • cancelEvent

      public void cancelEvent(String eventId, String cancelledByUid, Runnable onSuccess, Consumer<String> onFailure)
      Cancels an event by setting its status to Event.STATUS_CANCELLED and fanning out a Notification.TYPE_EVENT_CANCELLED notification to every attendee (and to the organizer when the canceller is someone else, e.g. an admin).
      Parameters:
      eventId - The event document ID.
      cancelledByUid - UID of whoever performed the cancellation; used to skip self-notify.
      onSuccess - Called after the status update succeeds (notif fan-out is fire-and-forget).
      onFailure - Called with an error message if the status update fails.

      public com.google.firebase.firestore.ListenerRegistration listenEvent(String eventId, Consumer<Event> onUpdate, Consumer<String> onError)

    • rsvpToEvent

      public void rsvpToEvent(String eventId, String userId, Runnable onSuccess, Consumer<String> onFailure)
      Adds userId to the event's attendeeIds array and increments rsvpCount by 1, enforcing the event's capacity limit. Uses a Firestore transaction to atomically read-then-write, preventing overbooking when multiple users RSVP concurrently.

    • cancelRsvp

      public void cancelRsvp(String eventId, String userId, Runnable onSuccess, Consumer<String> onFailure)
      Removes userId from the event's attendeeIds array and decrements rsvpCount by 1. Both updates are applied atomically.

    • getRsvpTimestamps

      public void getRsvpTimestamps(String eventId, Consumer<List<Long>> onSuccess, Consumer<String> onFailure)
      Fetches RSVP timestamps for an event from the rsvps subcollection, sorted ascending. Used by EventStats for the per-day timeline chart.

    • checkInAttendee

      public void checkInAttendee(String eventId, String userId, Runnable onSuccess, Consumer<String> onFailure)
      Adds userId to the event's checkedInIds array. Uses FieldValue.arrayUnion for atomic, idempotent writes.

    • removeCheckIn

      public void removeCheckIn(String eventId, String userId, Runnable onSuccess, Consumer<String> onFailure)
      Removes userId from the event's checkedInIds array. Uses FieldValue.arrayRemove for atomic writes.

    • fetchCategories

      public void fetchCategories(Consumer<List<String>> onSuccess, Consumer<String> onFailure)
      One-shot fetch of all category names from the categories collection. Each document must have a name String field. Results are sorted alphabetically. Used to populate the filter overlay's category chips.

    • saveRating

      public void saveRating(String eventId, String userId, int rating, Runnable onSuccess, Consumer<String> onFailure)
      Saves a rating (1–5) for a user on an event. Stored as events/{eventId}.ratings.{userId} so it uses the same collection permissions as RSVP/check-in writes — no separate rules needed.

    • fetchRating

      public void fetchRating(String eventId, String userId, Consumer<Integer> onSuccess, Consumer<String> onFailure)
      Fetches the user's saved rating for an event. Calls onSuccess with the rating (1–5), or null if not yet rated.

    • fetchAverageRating

      public void fetchAverageRating(String eventId, Consumer<Double> onSuccess, Consumer<String> onFailure)
      Computes the average rating for an event across all raters. Calls onSuccess with the average (1.0–5.0), or null if no ratings exist.

    • fetchOrganizerAverageRating

      public void fetchOrganizerAverageRating(String organizerId, Consumer<Double> onSuccess, Consumer<String> onFailure)
      Fetches the aggregate average rating for an organizer across all their events. Calls onSuccess with the average (1.0–5.0), or null if no ratings exist.

    • saveReview

      public void saveReview(String eventId, String userId, String review, Runnable onSuccess, Consumer<String> onFailure)
      Saves a text review for a user on an event. Stored as events/{eventId}.reviews.{userId} alongside the ratings map.

    • fetchReview

      public void fetchReview(String eventId, String userId, Consumer<String> onSuccess, Consumer<String> onFailure)
      Fetches the user's saved review text for an event. Calls onSuccess with the review string, or null if none exists yet.

    • fetchAllReviews

      public void fetchAllReviews(String eventId, Consumer<List<Review>> onSuccess, Consumer<String> onFailure)
      Fetches all reviews for an event, joining each reviewer's display name from the users collection. Calls onSuccess with a list of Review objects — one per user who has a stored review entry (text may be empty).
